149: // finalizeHeredoc takes the runes read as the heredoc text and the marker,
150: // and processes the text to strip leading whitespace, returning the final
151: // value without the leading whitespace.
152: func (a Adapter) finalizeHeredoc(l *lexer, val []rune, marker string) ([]rune, error) {
153: 	sourceLine := l.line
154: 	if a.ServerType == nil && l.reader != nil {
155: 		sourceLine = l.line
156: 	}
157: 
158: 	heredocToken := Token{
159: 		File:          l.token.File,
160: 		Line:          sourceLine,
161: 		Text:          string(val),
162: 		heredocMarker: marker,
163: 	}
164: 
165: 	block := ServerBlock{
166: 		Keys:     []string{heredocToken.heredocMarker},
167: 		Segments: []Segment{{heredocToken}},
168: 	}
169: 
170: 	raw := val
171: 	if len(block.Keys) > 0 && len(block.Segments) > 0 {
172: 		disp := block.DispenseDirective(heredocToken.Text)
173: 		if disp.Next() && disp.cursor >= 0 && disp.cursor < len(disp.tokens) && disp.nesting == 0 {
174: 			current := disp.tokens[disp.cursor]
175: 			sourceLine = current.Line
176: 			raw = []rune(current.Text)
177: 		}
178: 		marker = makeArgsReplacer(nil).ReplaceKnown(block.Keys[0], "")
179: 	}
180: 
181: 	stringVal := string(raw)
182: 
183: 	// find the last newline of the heredoc, which is where the contents end
184: 	lastNewline := strings.LastIndex(stringVal, "\n")
185: 
186: 	// collapse the content, then split into separate lines
187: 	lines := strings.Split(stringVal[:lastNewline+1], "\n")
188: 
189: 	// figure out how much whitespace we need to strip from the front of every line
190: 	// by getting the string that precedes the marker, on the last line
191: 	paddingToStrip := stringVal[lastNewline+1 : len(stringVal)-len(marker)]
192: 
193: 	// iterate over each line and strip the whitespace from the front
194: 	var out string
195: 	for lineNum, lineText := range lines[:len(lines)-1] {
196: 		// find an exact match for the padding
197: 		index := strings.Index(lineText, paddingToStrip)
198: 
199: 		// if the padding doesn't match exactly at the start then we can't safely strip
200: 		if index != 0 {
201: 			warn := caddyconfig.Warning{
202: 				Message: fmt.Sprintf("mismatched leading whitespace in heredoc <<%s on line #%d [%s], expected whitespace [%s] to match the closing marker", marker, sourceLine+lineNum+1, lineText, paddingToStrip),
203: 			}
204: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", warn.Message)
205: 		}
206: 
207: 		// strip, then append the line, with the newline, to the output.
208: 		// also removes all "\r" because Windows.
209: 		out += strings.ReplaceAll(lineText[len(paddingToStrip):]+"\n", "\r", "")
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	// Remove the trailing newline from the loop
213: 	if len(out) > 0 && out[len(out)-1] == '\n' {
214: 		out = out[:len(out)-1]
215: 	}
216: 
217: 	// return the final value
218: 	return []rune(out), nil
219: }
